correctness.rationale: The prescribed dense K_{2,2} and sparse matching links give each cluster vertex exactly three neighbors and connected isomorphic graphs. Checking the two dense votes against the one sparse vote gives the Boolean identity M_j(t+1)=M_{j−1}(t) M_{j+1}(t), hence a moving conjunction over t+1 indices on one cyclic parity subsequence. All nonconstant parity words ultimately turn all-zero, with exact arrival time equal to the longest cyclic 1-run; all-ones persists. On the four uniform-by-parity mixedness templates, the two-step payload map permutes two m-cycles and is bijective, so these and only these states recur. Count 4×2^(2m)=4^(m+1) recurrent states, use Möbius inversion on two binary necklaces to derive N_(2d)=(4/d)∑_(e|d)μ(d/e)4^e and all d|m; cyclic finite-state trace counts mixedness words without a longer 1-run. Independently implemented direct vertex-level simulation exhausted all 2^(4m) configurations at m=2,3,4 and checked the exact entry-time and period formulas. These finite checks are corroboration; moving-AND and return permutation prove all m.
